title: Overriding a bound store's exported method does not intercept the library's internal subscription path
trigger: Side-effect lifecycle (document listener, resource acquire) is gated on 'first React subscriber' by monkey-patching/overriding an exported store method
principle: React hooks subscribe through the library's internal store api, not the overridden property on the bound-store function object — so subscriber-counted side effects silently never fire. Attach event listeners unconditionally at module init (guard `typeof document`), or use the library's supported subscribe API; never infer React mount state from an exported-method override.

cases.context: Subtitle block stuck on 'Loading EN-US #1…' while panel renders fine — Tihoka:cues:updated listener was attached inside an overridden useCuesStore.subscribe that only ran on first external subscriber, but zustand v5 hooks call the internal api.subscribe, leaving the count at 0 forever.
cases.bad: useCuesStore.subscribe = ((...args) => { if (count === 0) document.addEventListener(EVT, h); count++; const u = base(...args); return () => { u(); if (--count === 0) document.removeEventListener(EVT, h); }; })

applyFor: any external-store lib wrapped with useSyncExternalStore
monkey-patching exported functions to detect framework lifecycle
